title: Cross-authority work runs as coupled triplets in pipeline order
statement: Work that spans the authority chain MUST be grouped as an Architect task, an Inspector task, and an Engineer task sharing one coupled task group, each downstream branch MUST be created from the upstream head, and merges MUST follow the authority order Architect, Inspector, Engineer with downstream rebase after each upstream merge.
rationale: Article 24 turns the authority chain into a branch pipeline so that no discipline sets its own reference and actuates against it.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
